name: Guiro scrape and tumba groove
desc: vcsl guiro playing the long-short 'rasca' scrape (an elongated down-stroke plus two up-ticks) with its speed alternating cycle to cycle, waveshaped for body, anchored by a soft uzu low-tom tumba pulse and a pumping shaker/cabasa 16th bed. Filters and pans drift on opposite phases; peak rotates a cabasa euclid and fires double-time scrape fills.

code.sparse: stack(s("[guiro@2 guiro guiro]*2").speed("<.95 1.15 1.1>").gain(${gain}).shape(.4).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.1).slow(16)).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.42, .58).slow(24)), s("lt ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ lt ~").gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.35).speed(1.2).lpf(2200).pan(.45), s("sh*8").gain("[.38 .2 .3 .19]*2").shape(.2).hpf(3000).pan(.62)).orbit(2).play()
code.full: stack(s("[guiro@2 guiro guiro]*2").speed("<.95 1.15 1.1 1.2>").gain(${gain}).shape(.55).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.4, .6).slow(24)), s("lt ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ lt ~ ~ ~ lt ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.4).speed(1.2).lpf(2400).pan(.45), s("sh*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.75, ${shk}).fast(4)).shape(.2).hpf(sine.range(3000, 7000).slow(32)).pan(cosine.range(.35, .55).slow(16)), s("cabasa(3,8,<0 2>)").gain(${shk}*.9).shape(.25).speed(1.3).hpf(2000).pan(.4)).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[guiro@2 guiro guiro]*2").speed("<.95 1.15 1.1 1.2>").gain(${gain}).shape(.55).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(12)).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.4, .6).slow(16)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~ ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.45).speed(1.2).lpf(2600).pan(.45), s("sh*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.75, ${shk}).fast(4)).shape(.25).hpf(sine.range(3500, 7500).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.32, .56).slow(12)), s("cabasa(5,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${shk}*.9).shape(.3).speed(1.3).hpf(2200).pan(.38)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
